_comment: Single source of truth for hardcoded (non-manifest) room surface textures. Referenced by MaterialParser.ts, EmptyRoom.tsx, and all prewarmers. Changing a texture here propagates everywhere automatically.

emptyFloor._comment: Vacant structural scaffold — the 'Empty Floor' placement type.

emptyRoom._comment: EmptyRoom.tsx entity — rendered when an empty floor cell is placed. Floor must match emptyFloor.

structure._comment: Structural scaffold shell — concrete columns and beams rendered in SimulationNodes.tsx.

structureFrame._comment: Frame material used for structural window trim and getEmptyRoomMaterials frameMaterial.
